name: Christmas on Las Olas
address: Las Olas Blvd between SE 6th Ave and SE 11th Ave, Fort Lauderdale, FL
paras: The Las Olas Association hosts its 64th annual Christmas on Las Olas as a free, family friendly, one night only celebration. The boulevard is closed to stroll between 6th and 11th Avenues, with Snow Mountain for sledding, a free ice skating rink with skate rentals and a Santa's Village for wish lists and photos.

Performances come from more than 30 local schools and organizations on stages at 6th Avenue, 8th Avenue and 10th Terrace, and the host lists more than 60 holiday marketplace vendors. Stanley the Florida Panther makes an appearance.
tip: The host suggests the Water Taxi or Circuit to beat the traffic.

name: Holiday Magic: Whimsical Wonderland at Bonnet House
address: 900 N Birch Rd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33304
cost: $40 nonmember adults, $35 member adults, $15 ages 13 to 17, $5 ages 6 to 12, free ages 5 and under
paras: Bonnet House Museum and Gardens calls Whimsical Wonderland the family evening of its Holiday Magic celebration. Guests are encouraged to wear holiday pajamas for holiday arts and crafts, letters to Santa, storytelling and live music.

Santa arrives on a historic fire truck at 6:30 PM. Guests can also take self guided tours of the decorated historic house, take family photos and enjoy complimentary fare. The arts calendar listing says advance reservations are encouraged and free parking is available in the visitor lot.
tip: Santa's fire truck arrival is at 6:30 PM, one hour into the evening.
